people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”
translations.bsb: “If we have found favor in your sight,” they said, “let this land be given to your servants as a possession. Do not make us cross the Jordan.”
translations.kjv: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.
translations.asv: And they said, If we have found favor in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession; bring us not over the Jordan.
